title: mkviz-engine: calculations and chart data behind MKViz
description:
The calculation engine and per-article chart data behind MKViz (mkviz.com), a blog that explains US money news with long-run official data from FRED, BLS and EIA. Each folder holds the inputs, settings and output of one chart published on mkviz.com, with a command that reproduces it.

New in this version:

  • When Was the Last Yield Curve Inversion? What History Says (data)
